This is a pharmaceutical-grade quality management system for cannabis cultivation facilities.  BRAND & THEME: - Dark mode with deep slate/charcoal backgrounds (slate-900/950) - Emerald green (#10B981) as primary accent color - Professional, clinical aesthetic suitable for pharmaceutical compliance - Typography: Inter for UI, JetBrains Mono for code/document content - Rounded corners (lg/xl), subtle glass-morphism effects  PAGES TO DESIGN:  1. DASHBOARD - Welcome header with user greeting - 4 stat cards: Total SOPs, Departments, Approved Docs, Pending Reviews - Recent activity feed showing last 5 documents with status badges - Quick action buttons: \"Create New SOP\", \"Browse Templates\" - Document health/compliance score widget - Mini chart showing document creation trends  2. SOP CREATION WIZARD (5-step flow) - Step indicator showing: Metadata → Scope → Content → Annexes → Review - Step 1: Form with SOP name, code (auto-suggested), department dropdown, facility type selector, document type toggle (SOP/Protocol/Work Instruction) - Step 2: Scope definition with rich text area and scope elements chips - Step 3: Dynamic questionnaire with sections, questions, and answer inputs - Step 4: Annex configuration with add/remove capability - Step 5: Review summary with all entered data in a clean card layout - Progress bar and back/next navigation  3. DOCUMENT GENERATION VIEW - Split view: Left side shows agent pipeline (vertical timeline with 10 agents) - Agent cards showing: Agent name, icon, status (waiting/working/done/error) - Animated pulse effect on currently active agent - Right side: Live document preview with streaming content - Quality report panel: Overall score, section scores, compliance checks with pass/fail indicators - Download button when complete  4. DOCUMENT LIBRARY - Search bar with filters (status, department, date range) - View toggle: Grid cards vs. List table - Document cards showing: Title, SOP code, department badge, status badge, last modified date - Sidebar with QMS document hierarchy tree (collapsible) - Document detail panel (slides in from right) with full metadata, version history, action buttons  5. KNOWLEDGE/RAG SEARCH - Large search input with \"Ask your knowledge base\" placeholder - Search results as cards with source document, relevance score, excerpt with highlighted matches - Suggested queries  COMPONENT STYLES: - Buttons: Primary (emerald filled), Secondary (slate outline), Ghost (transparent), Danger (red) - Status badges: Draft (amber), Review (blue), Approved (emerald), Archived (slate) - Cards: Slight elevation, slate-800 border, hover effect with emerald border accent - Inputs: Dark backgrounds (slate-800), slate-700 border, focus ring emerald-500 - Modals: Centered with backdrop blur, smooth scale animation  NAVIGATION: - Collapsible left sidebar with icons + labels - Menu items: Dashboard, Create SOP, Documents, Knowledge, Settings - Bottom: Collapse toggle button - Top bar: Page title, theme toggle (sun/moon), user avatar  Make it feel premium, trustworthy, and suitable for a regulated pharmaceutical environment. The UI should convey precision and compliance while being pleasant to use."}
